title: Outlook mobile: Purview DLP policy tips for iOS and Android (Worldwide)
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents the disabled-by-default mobile policy tip UI, administrator enablement, and the listed automation and audit controls. Two navigation clarifications and a checklist reference to controls not represented in the table need minor corrections.

claims.claim: The mobile policy tip reference covers macOS alongside Android and iOS.
claims.quote: Data loss prevention policy tip reference for Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS

claims.claim: The policy tip UI is disabled by default and requires an administrator to enable it.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; What's changing
claims.claim: The setting is reached in Microsoft 365 Apps admin center through Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Configure Settings > Enable Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips in Outlook.
claims.quote: Under Customization, select Policy Management. ... Open the configuration details of the policy configuration you want to change by selecting it. ... On the Configure Settings page, select the policies that you want to include in the policy configuration.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Android and iOS oversharing dialog displays warning, override or block popups for sensitive or labelled emails.
claims.quote: When you enable this feature in a DLP rule, it displays popups for warning, override, or block actions to end users who are sharing labeled or sensitive emails in Outlook for Android and iOS.

claims.claim: The mobile oversharing dialog requires the necessary licences and configuration.
claims.quote: The oversharing dialog is available in DLP for Outlook for Android and iOS users when used with the necessary licenses and configuration.

claims.claim: The default oversharing dialog has noncustomizable justification options when an override is applicable.
claims.quote:
Default oversharing dialog

This dialog uses the exact same text as the policy tip (default or custom) and, when applicable, a noncustomizable set of justification options to override the policy.

claims.quote: DLP checks email messages before they're sent for any labeled or sensitive information and apply the actions defined in the DLP policy.

claims.claim: The DLP rule controls the policy tip text.
claims.quote: For each rule in a DLP policy, you can configure policy tips to: ... You can use the default text ... or enter custom text about your organization's specific policies.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies is the documented start of the route to the rule's oversharing dialog option.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies ... Set the User notifications toggle to On. Select Policy tips > Show the policy tip as a dialog for the end user before send (available for Exchange workload only).
claims.fix: Replace the early-stopping creation route with 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom > Admin units > Full directory > Exchange email > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Create rule > User notifications > On > Policy tips > Show the policy tip as a dialog for the end user before send (available for Exchange workload only)', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-osp-get-started. Retain the existing note that this example is for Outlook for Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Set-DlpComplianceRule -Identity <rule name> -NotifyPolicyTipDisplayOption Dialog sets a rule's policy tip to display as a popup dialog.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the DLP rule that you want to modify. ... Name ... -NotifyPolicyTipDisplayOption ... Dialog: Displays policy tip at the top of the mail and as a popup dialog. (exchange only)

claims.claim: The dialog option is Policy tips > Show the policy tip as a dialog for the end user before send (available for Exchange workload only), with User notifications On.
claims.quote: Set the User notifications toggle to On. Select Policy tips > Show the policy tip as a dialog for the end user before send (available for Exchange workload only).
